analyst_view.overall: Union Saint-Gilloise are 4th in the Europa League with 10 points and top of the Belgian league after a 1-0 win at Kortrijk on Sunday; David Hubert's side play this home game at Den Dreef in Leuven. Union were without defender Massiré Sylla at Kortrijk (unclear if injured or rested after a long Senegal trip) and Nikky Havenaar, with captain Kevin Mac Allister out long-term; Biondic's knock is already counted in the numbers. Lech Poznan lead the Polish league after a 1-0 win at GKS Katowice but have only 1 point in Europe, and Niels Frederiksen wants a win here or against Ferencvaros. Lech are without captain and striker Mikael Ishak (hamstring, likely out until the winter break), Walemark, Moutinho, Gholizadeh and Douglas, all on the numbers' list, and Daniel Håkans felt knee discomfort in Sunday's warm-up but was expected to train on Tuesday. No referee is named; nothing new points clearly either way, so I keep the numbers.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals, 2.6 for Union, with Biondic's absence already taken off. Lech are without Ishak, their captain and main striker, since late October, so their recent scoring already reflects that, and Håkans should be fit; Union's possible absence of Sylla at the back is a small, unconfirmed doubt, so I stay at about 3.4.

corners.text: The numbers expect 8.2 corners, already trimming Union for their low recent corner count. Lech are short of wingers with Walemark out and Håkans only just recovering, but their side is already small (3.1), so I stay at about 8.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards, already lowered for both sides' calm recent records. Lech need points but are a passing side rather than a rough one, Union play a controlled game at home, and no referee is named yet, so I stay at about 3.6.

shots.text: The numbers expect 30.8 shots, with Union expected to dominate (21.3). Both clubs play league games three days later, but Frederiksen needs points and Union keep a settled side, so the open game the numbers assume still fits and I stay at about 31.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.6 shots on target, already adding for Union's accurate recent shooting. Union hit the woodwork and had chances at Kortrijk, and Lech's attack without Ishak is what their recent games already show, so I stay at about 11.6.
